pue.definition: v. i. To make a low whistling sound; to chirp, as birds.

n. a city in Colorado to the south of Colorado Springs
n. a communal village built by Indians in the southwestern United States

puebloan.translation: [网络] 韦普峡谷峭壁上普韦布洛；柏洛；原着民

pueblos.definition:
plural of pueblo

n. a city in Colorado to the south of Colorado Springs

pueblos.translation: (pueblo 的复数) n. 普韦布洛印第安人, 印第安人村庄

puerile.definition: a. of or characteristic of a child

a. 孩子气的, 天真的, 未成熟的
[医] 儿童的, 幼稚的

puerilely.definition: adv. In a puerile manner; childishly.
puerilely.translation: adv. <贬>幼稚地; 孩子气地; 天真地

puerpera.definition: n a woman in childbirth or shortly thereafter

puerperal.definition: a. relating to or connected with or occurring at the time of childbirth or shortly following, or to the woman who has just given birth
puerperal.translation:
a. 分娩的, 产后的
[医] 产褥期的, 产后的

puerperium.definition: n. time period following childbirth when the mother's uterus shrinks and the other functional and anatomic changes of pregnancy are resolved
puerperium.translation:
n. 产后期
[医] 产褥期, 产后期

puerperous.translation: [医] 产褥期的, 产后的
